text: dsh-plugin-token-usage 是面向 DSH Web 的本地 token 用量插件，在侧边栏提供统计面板和对话工具 usage_report。它读取本机 DSH 会话日志，按日、模型和会话汇总输入、输出及缓存 token，并计算缓存命中率。面板可切换日、周、月范围查看热力图与模型明细；悬停侧栏入口可见今日用量。适合想了解本地会话消耗和模型趋势的用户。需能访问 ~/.dsh/sessions 并具备 zstd 命令，无需 API Key。

dsh-plugin-token-usage tracks local token use in DSH web. Its sidebar panel and usage_report tool summarize daily and per-model totals, including cache rates. View a heat map by day, week, or month and today's total on hover. It reads local logs and needs zstd, with no API key.
我想看看最近每天用了多少 token。
能按周或按月汇总我的模型用量吗？
想比较不同模型分别消耗了多少输入和输出 token。
DSH 有没有办法显示缓存 token 的命中比例？
Show me which local sessions used the most tokens this month.
How can I check token usage and cache hit rates by model?
让侧边栏提示我今天累计用了多少 token。
不打开统计界面，也想在对话里问当前用量。
dsh-plugin-token-usage 的功能「每日用量热力图」：在 Web 面板按日展示本地会话 token 消耗，并可切换日、周、月范围。点击侧边栏图表入口打开面板。
dsh-plugin-token-usage 的功能「按模型统计」：汇总各模型的请求数、输入输出 token 与缓存命中率，面板明细随所选日、周或月范围更新。
dsh-plugin-token-usage 的功能「对话用量报告」：通过 usage_report 工具返回总量、模型明细和逐日统计；可请求强制重扫，并限制返回的模型条数。
dsh-plugin-token-usage 的功能「侧栏今日用量提示」：侧边栏图表按钮悬停时显示今日 token 总量，并每 30 秒从本地统计接口刷新。

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · dsh-plugin-token-usage：A DeepSeek Harness plugin that read-only scans your local session logs and renders a
**GitHub-style token usage heat map** with a granularity-linked per-model breakdown —
plus an instant "tokens today" badge on hover. Everything stays on your machine.

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · dsh-plugin-token-usage：> Compatibility: targets DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.x` (verified on `0.2.1-rc.3`). The tool
> run-card registers in the `tool.call.toolview` key domain under the wire tool name
> `usage_report`; the legacy `tool.view.cordis/self` slot is now owned by the dynamic
> Client Guard and no longer applies to static plugins.
>
> Both session-log generations are supported: the old `session.jsonl.zstd`
> (`assistant/chunk` + `chunk.usage`) and the new `session.v3.jsonl.zstd`
> (`assistant/message` + `data.usage`, model attributed per message source). When both
> coexist in one session directory only the highest version is read, so no stretch of
> history is counted twice.

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Features：- 🔥 **GitHub-style heat map**: one cell per day for the last 30 days (zero-usage days
  filled), Sunday-first columns, month labels, today outlined; 5-level accent scale
  normalized per view.
- 🗓 **Day / Week / Month switcher**: weeks start on Sunday, aligned with grid columns;
  the color scale renormalizes per granularity.
- 🫧 **First-party tooltips**: `08-22 · 420M token · 341 requests · 95.9% cache hit`,
  left-edge aligned to each cell, shown instantly (`delayMs=0`), viewport-aware flip.
- 🧩 **Granularity-linked model table**: exact in-window aggregation via session×day and
  model×day secondary maps (no approximations), with window totals row and empty state.
- ⚡ **Sidebar hover badge**: `1.25亿token today`, silent 30s polling, rolls over at
  midnight automatically.
- 🚿 **Zero-usage filtering**: models that only produced requests but no real tokens are
  excluded from the breakdown and from request totals.
- 🌗 **Theme-native**: every color maps to DSH theme variables (`--dsw-alias-*`);
  light/dark just work.
- 🛠 **`usage_report` model tool**: ask your agent "how many tokens did I use today?"
  without opening the panel.

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Option A (recommended): one command, self-mounting：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-token-usage
```

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml` bundle patch, so the host half (HTTP API +
model tool) activates automatically.

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Option B: manual mount：1. Put this directory into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/`
   (or `pnpm add file:` it);
2. Append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: token-usage
         name: 'dsh-plugin-token-usage'
         config:

3. Restart DeepSeek Harness.

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Option B: manual mount：> ⚠️ Pick one. If the bundle patch already mounts it, do NOT manually insert the same id —
> that would double-load the plugin.
>
> **Upgrading from the manual install?** If you previously added the `insert` block above
> to your profile, **delete it before restarting** — with the self-mounting bundle patch
> present, the same id would be registered twice and startup crashes with
> `duplicate loader entry id: token-usage`.

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ttlMs` | `15000` | Scan result cache duration (ms) |
| `scanTimeoutMs` | `180000` | Per-log decompression timeout (ms) |

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Usage：- **Web GUI**: click the bar-chart icon on the sidebar settings row → usage modal;
  Esc or click the backdrop to close.
- **Chat tool**: ask your agent to call `usage_report` (`refresh` forces a rescan,
  `top` caps model rows — default 10, max 50).

dsh-plugin-token-usage README · Privacy：Read-only parsing of local logs under `~/.dsh/sessions/**` (streamed zstd decompression,
8-way concurrency). No network requests, no telemetry, no writes.
